issues: Winner model and score model favor different teams
blocking_issues: Winner model and score model favor different teams
history_health.thresholds: Five games / 400 days and 60-day staleness are diagnostic flags, not validated selection thresholds.
unknowns: Historical publication times for retrospectively collected results
history_health.note: Data adequacy is separate from win probability; no validated recommendation or accuracy guarantee.

prior_selection.rule: Lowest log loss on the second UTC-day half of the preceding season. Score probabilities calibrate on its first half. Fixed learners; test outcomes never select a candidate.

frozen_pipeline_policy.rule: First prior OOS UTC-day half calibrates; second half selects. Require +1 percentage point accuracy, -0.005 log loss and no worse Brier versus calibrated baseline. Otherwise retain baseline. No current/future outcome selection.
